font_system.character_support: Full Latin Extended (č, ć, š, đ, ž, Č, Ć, Š, Đ, Ž)

brand_assets.tagline: Prve i najbrže vijesti iz Cazina i Krajine

public_header.top_bar: Date, Cazin Weather summary (-2°C / 14°C), Border Queue status ticker, Theme Toggle, Admin Link
public_header.main_brand_bar: Deep Navy (#0B1F3B) background, Gold Feather Pen logo + 'Cazin Čaršija Novosti', Search input with dropdown preview, Breaking Red live count badge
public_header.nav_strip: Horizontal category navigation: Naslovna, Cazin & Krajina, Region, Svijet, Hronika, Kultura & Sport, Kamere uživo, Video
public_header.breaking_ticker: Full-width Breaking Red (#E1142B) bar with scrolling ticker, pause-on-hover, direct click to breaking article

public_homepage_grid.hero_section: Bento layout 12-cols (8-col dominant featured story with rich badge & author metadata, 4-col stacked secondary top news)
public_homepage_grid.live_border_cameras: Dedicated interactive strip for HAK border crossings (GP Maljevac, GP Izačić, GP Hadžin Potok, GP Velika Kladuša) with 10s auto-refresh snapshot toggle, live wait times (min), expandable modal
public_homepage_grid.weather_widget: Detailed Cazin 5-day forecast, humidity, wind, air quality index, hourly timeline
public_homepage_grid.category_blocks: Two-column grid for 'Cazin & Krajina' (with local tag filter) + 'Region & Svijet' (high density cards)
public_homepage_grid.multimedia_section: Dark navy background container featuring Video News player with playlist, Photo Galleries modal preview
public_homepage_grid.sidebar_features: Most Read 24h (numbered ranking 1-5), Opinion/Kolumne, Sponsor Ad Slots (300x250, 728x90 banners), Newsletter subscribe form

article_page.header: Breadcrumb, Category tag pill (Turquoise #00C2B8), Title (Merriweather text-3xl md:text-5xl bold), Subtitle lead paragraph, Author avatar + name, Published/Updated timestamp, Reading time, View count, Share buttons (Facebook, WhatsApp, Viber, Copy Link)
article_page.hero_image: High-res lead image with caption, photo credit, and subtle gradient container
article_page.body_content: Rich text typography (leading-relaxed, drop cap, pull quotes, inline ad slots, interactive image galleries, embedded video)
article_page.footer_meta: Article tags, Author bio card, Source attribution, Comments section with nested replies & reaction emojis, Related articles 3-card grid

admin_cms_layout.sidebar: Dark navy (#0B1F3B) vertical menu: Dashboard, Članci (Articles list & rich editor), Kategorije, Oznake (Tags), Mediji (Media library), Početna (Homepage Builder), Breking Vijesti, Oglasi (Ads manager), Komentari, Građanske Vijesti (User submitted), Bilten (Newsletter), Korisnici & Uloge, Kamere (Border feeds), AI Asistent, Audit Log, Postavke
admin_cms_layout.dashboard_stats: 4 key metric cards (Total Views Today, Active Breaking News, Draft/Pending Reviews, Camera Uptime), Recharts line chart of weekly traffic, recent published table, fast action shortcuts
admin_cms_layout.article_editor: Title input, permalink slug, rich text editor toolbar, status badge select (draft/review/approved/scheduled/published/archived), category/tags select, cover image uploader, AI Assistant drawer for auto-summaries & proofreading

component_styling_rules.cards: Clean borders (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), rounded-lg, subtle hover shadow transition (hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5)
component_styling_rules.buttons: Primary: Navy #0B1F3B or Turquoise #00C2B8 with crisp contrast. Breaking/Alert: Red #E1142B. Gold accents: #D4A52C for highlights & badges
component_styling_rules.badges: Category pills with distinct background colors (Cazin: Turquoise, Breaking: Red, Region: Navy, Sport: Green)
component_styling_rules.ads: Clearly designated ad slots with 'Oglas / Reklama' label in small uppercase tracking-wider

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, navigation links, camera toggles, category tabs, and admin workflow buttons MUST have unique kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='breaking-ticker', data-testid='border-camera-refresh-btn', data-testid='admin-article-save-btn').
